en.headline: TST East Halloween Beats holds free cosplay DJ party today
en.dek: Sino Group’s Tsim Sha Tsui Centre and Empire Centre stage the Movie Magic themed event at Mody Road Garden from 4pm to 10pm, with Hong Kong Tourism Board support.
body: A free cosplay and DJ party under the banner TST East Halloween Beats takes place today at Mody Road Garden in Tsim Sha Tsui East.

The event is organised by Sino Group’s Tsim Sha Tsui Centre and Empire Centre with the support of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. It is the second of three Saturday sessions this month. Today’s theme is Movie Magic, inviting participants to dress as characters from films of different eras and regions.

Activities run from 4pm to 10pm. A family carnival with games is scheduled from 4pm to 6pm. Neon photo installations are on site, including ones featuring original characters created by local artiste Kenny Kwan. DJs including international and local performers are listed for the evening sets.
Admission is free. The organisers said similar sessions were held on 17 October and will be held again on 31 October, when the event runs until 11pm.

zh.headline: 尖東萬聖節音樂盛事今日舉行免費變裝DJ派對
zh.dek: 信和集團旗下尖沙咀中心及帝國中心主辦的活動，以電影狂想曲為主題，於麼地道花園下午4時至晚上10時舉行，並獲旅遊發展局支持。
body: 名為「TST East Halloween Beats」的免費變裝及DJ派對今日在尖沙咀東部麼地道花園舉行。
活動由信和集團旗下尖沙咀中心及帝國中心主辦，並獲香港旅遊發展局支持。這是本月三個星期六場次中的第二場。今日主題為電影狂想曲，歡迎參加者以不同年代及地區電影角色造型出席。
活動時間由下午4時至晚上10時。下午4時至6時設有親子嘉年華及遊戲。場地設有霓虹拍照裝置，包括本地藝人關智斌創作角色的裝置。晚間有國際及本地DJ演出。
入場免費。主辦單位表示，類似場次已於10月17日舉行，並將於10月31日再辦，當日活動延長至晚上11時。
